title: Design decisions
text: D-001 (2026-11-20) Package name trainingmodels. Checked pak::pkg_name_check: valid, free CRAN Bioconductor. D-002 (2026-11-18) First version scope: daily-series core, load descriptors, Banister impulse-response model. Later: Busso variable dose-response, fitness delay, Kalman filter, Bayesian version, DLNM via dlnm package (wrapped, reimplemented). D-003 (2026-11-18) Every formula verified source implementation; verification source recorded per method. D-004 (2026-11-18) Every method documented limitations (identifiability, wide intervals, assumptions), computation. D-005 (2026-11-18) Public repository day one; issues, pull requests releases; AI use disclosed (see AI_USAGE.md). D-006 (2026-11-18) pkgdown site start, one article per method. D-007 (2026-11-18) Numerical tests published examples independent reference implementation. D-008 (2026-11-18) Code, documentation commits English. D-009 (2026-11-19) package code written verified formulas; third-party code used external reference tests, never copied. D-010 (2026-11-20) bib/ folder (copyrighted papers) never committed. D-011 (2026-11-24) Impulse-response functions implement timing conventions found literature, selected argument same_day_load: “exclude” (sum n-1; Busso & Chalencon 2023) “include” (Morton et al. 1990, Eqs. 4-5). Reason: two forms equivalent use; see MODELS.md, M-01. D-012 (2026-11-24) default same_day_load = "exclude". Every fitted object stores prints convention, gains fitted one convention comparable . D-013 (2026-11-24) MODELS.md model registry single source truth formulas, verification sources, reference values literature discrepancies. first version (entries M-01 M-09) approved author 2026-11-24. D-014 (2026-11-25) package app ship pre-built example datasets modelled published studies; simulated labelled simulated. impulse-response models share one data format (daily load plus performance days). app explains format variables collect users upload data. D-015 (2026-11-25) Every day one three states: training (load > 0), rest (load = 0), missing (load available). Days row athlete’s first last date treated rest default, message listing many filled, warning 7 consecutive days filled. user can request days treated missing instead. D-016 (2026-11-25) Missing loads never silently replaced. Descriptors return NA windows containing missing day. Impulse-response models refuse run series missing loads unless user explicitly chooses fill ; first version option zero. D-017 (2026-11-25) data file may contain several athletes (optional identifier column) several load columns; analysis uses one load column chosen user.

title: Design decisions
text: -001 One daily-series class single entry point: validates input, sums -day sessions, marks day observed, rest missing. -002 Daily-calendar core adapted author’s ACWR 0.2.0 package (copied, imported). ACWR may later become wrapper. -003 Shiny app repository, shiny Suggests. -004 One exponential-filter engine impulse-response models (fitness-, Banister, fitness delay), computed recursive form. -005 Two-level fit: linear regression baseline gains, numerical search time constants (Busso & Chalencon 2023). -006 Model comparison AICc Akaike weights. -007 Reference values tests generated outside package R script Busso & Chalencon (2023, Supplemental Digital Content 2) dorem package; neither dependency. -008 dlnm REDI Suggests, version 0.3. -010 core dependencies beyond base R, can run browser (Shinylive).

what: M-01 Exponential filter and the two timing conventions
title: Model registry
text: Status: verified (conventions) · planned 0.0.3 Author approval: approved 2026-11-24 (entry written; verification status unchanged) literature uses two different discrete forms. equivalent package offers argument same_day_load = c("exclude", "include"). default "exclude" (decisions D-011 D-012). Convention “include” (Morton, Fitz-Clarke & Banister 1990, Eqs. 4-5). load day tt counts day tt full weight; values refer end day tt. ginc(t)=ginc(t−1)e−1/τ+w(t)=∑s=1tw(s)e−(t−s)/τ g_{\mathrm{inc}}(t) = g_{\mathrm{inc}}(t-1)\,e^{-1/\tau} + w(t) = \sum_{s=1}^{t} w(s)\,e^{-(t-s)/\tau} Convention “exclude” (Busso lineage; sum t−1t-1). load day tt affect day tt; yesterday’s load already attenuated e−1/τe^{-1/\tau}. gexc(t)=∑s=1t−1w(s)e−(t−s)/τ,gexc(t)=[gexc(t−1)+w(t−1)]e−1/τ g_{\mathrm{exc}}(t) = \sum_{s=1}^{t-1} w(s)\,e^{-(t-s)/\tau}, \qquad g_{\mathrm{exc}}(t) = \left[g_{\mathrm{exc}}(t-1) + w(t-1)\right] e^{-1/\tau} Exact relationship (derived checked numerically): ginc(t)=gexc(t)+w(t),gexc(t+1)=e−1/τginc(t) g_{\mathrm{inc}}(t) = g_{\mathrm{exc}}(t) + w(t), \qquad g_{\mathrm{exc}}(t+1) = e^{-1/\tau}\,g_{\mathrm{inc}}(t) Consequences Gains kk fitted one convention comparable gains fitted . Every fitted object must store print convention. difference matters performance test training session fall day. “exclude” corresponds test done day’s training; “include” value end day. title: trainingmodels 0.0.1
text: New as_daily_load() builds complete daily calendar session data: -day sessions summed, every day marked training, rest missing, days without row filled rest (default) missing, warning long runs filled days (DECISIONS.md, D-015 D-017). Supports several athletes optional performance column. New print() summary() methods daily_load objects.
